title: Victoria Monét Reveals ‘Frequency of Love’ Track List, Featuring Bruno Mars, SZA, Bryson Tiller & Leon Thomas
summary: Frequency of Love arrives on Oct. 2.
contentText:
Victoria Monét’s Frequency of Love album is set to arrive next Friday, Oct. 2, and the Grammy-winning singer just revealed the LP’s star-studded track list.

Monét released a trailer for Frequency of Love , which recruits a range of collaborators across R&B, including SZA, Bruno Mars, Leon Thomas, Bryson Tiller, Chlöe and Lucky Daye. VM’s daughter, Hazel, will also make a special guest appearance.

Monét unveiled the track list with a cinematic trailer for the album, which saw excited fans claiming their favorite songs in the comments, while peers expressed they were hyped to see what Vic has in store come Oct. 2.

“This album is about to be insanityyyyy. grateful to be apart,” Chlöe wrote. JoJo set expectations sky high as she’s expecting a spectacular effort. “Wow this is about to be a CLASSIC,” the “Leave (Get Out)” singer added.

VM kicked off the rollout for Frequency of Love with a trio of singles: “Let Me” topped the Adult R&B Airplay chart in June, which was followed by the Kaytranada-produced “Reach Out” and “Juicy.”

The “On My Mama” singer served as an opener on Bruno Mars’ Romantic Tour and will headline her own trek when she hits the road for the Frequency of Love Tour in October.

The trek kicks off in Raleigh, N.C., before heading to Charlotte, New Orleans, Houston, Dallas, Tampa Bay, Boston, Detroit, Chicago, NYC, Pittsburgh, Nashville, Austin, Las Vegas, Seattle, Los Angeles, her hometown of Sacramento and will wrap up in San Francisco on Dec. 17.

View this post on Instagram

Frequency of Love  follows the the 37-year-old’s Jaguar II  album in 2023, which reached No. 60 on the  Billboard 200.
